Card Q&A.a: You choose 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon and place it under another of your opponent's Digimon as its bottom digivolution card or under an opponent's Tamer. For each Tamer you have in play with a different color, you add 1 to the maximum level you can choose with this effect. If you have a multicolor Tamer, you reference its colors that are different from your other Tamers and count it as 1 Tamer with a different color. For example, if you have a red Tamer, a red/blue Tamer, and a blue/yellow Tamer, you would refer to the red, blue, and yellow colors, then add +3 to the maximum level you can choose.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's [When Digivolving] effect do, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: If there are already any cards stacked under the Tamer, you place the new card at the bottom.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place a card under a Tamer that already has cards under it, in what order do I place the cards?
Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place 1 of my opponent's Digimon under another of their Digimon, one that isn't affected by effects?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it will leave the battle area. The digivolution cards of the Digimon to be placed in digivolution cards will be trashed at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place an opponent's Digimon under my opponent's other Digimon as its bottom digivolution card, will the Digimon to be placed in digivolution cards leave the battle area?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't. A Digimon will gain an inherited effect, but a Tamer doesn't gain it.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place an opponent's Digimon under one of their Tamers, does that Tamer gain the placed card's inherited effect?

Card Q&A.a:
Yes, it gains the inherited effect. If BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] suspends, BT12-038 [GeoGreymon]'s inherited effect will trigger. However, as soon as it is no longer treated as a Digimon, it will lose inherited effects.
